answer: Reputation-weighted escrow with operator liability. Each agent identity must lock a deposit proportional to its claimed transaction capacity; any linked cluster flagged by a single plume of coordinated behavior triggers slashing of the operator's shared deposit pool, not individual wallets. Because operators must post collateral covering all their identities, a sybil fleet multiplies the operator's capital at risk and any detection signal drains the whole pool. Repeated offenses also forfeit the operator's willow access tier, raising costs for every future identity they sponsor.
